english.title: Drive a mechanically propelled vehicle on a road / in a public place without due care and attention

english.legislation: Contrary to section 3 of the RoadTraffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) See section 13A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 for the disapplication of section 3 for authorised motoring events.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) The level of fine was raised to level five by section 23 of the Road Safety Act 2006.
(iv) Officers should ensure that they know the C.P.S. guidelines for this offence before preparing any charges. When investigating these offences consideration must be given to the advice offered in the charging standards.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three to nine penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed Penalty Ticket - One Hundred Pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
